sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government First Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXV OF 2001
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 17th September, 2001]
No. 1egis.1(18)70/4913-18,
dated 17-9-2001.---Thefollowing Ordinance made by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement, ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

7. Amendment of section 180 of
N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. XIV of 2001---In the said Ordinance, in section 180,--
(a)
the existing section shall be re-numbered as subsection (1) of section 180;
(b)
in subsection (1), as so re-numbered, after the figure " 123 ", the
words, brackets and figure "and
subsection (3) of this section "shall be inserted; and
(c)
after subsection (1), as so re-numbered, the following new sub section (2)
shall be added, namely:
"(2) Government shall have
the power to transfer such amounts from the fund of a dissolved Municipal
Corporation, Municipal Committee, Town Committee of District Council of a
District, as was available on the Thirteenth day of August, 2001, to any Local
Government in the same or any other District, where such transfer is considered
necessary by Government in the public interest."
